# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** Fifteen years old  <sub>[v4 c4 P2](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0002)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c8 P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is a fair child with gentle, mild hazel eyes and a straight nose. She has long, sleek curls that never get out of order and a "prunes and prisms" mouth. She often presents a neat and proper appearance, looking as though she has just been starched and ironed.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is demure, quiet, and exceptionally well-behaved, behaving like a model child and a little lady. She is neat, industrious, faithful, and observant, approaching her tasks and duties in a careful, systematic, and dispassionately routine manner. Exceedingly composed and placid, she is rarely disturbed by events that upset others. As she grows older, she proves to be sensible, careful, womanly, and helpful.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 c26 P33](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0033), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001), [v4 c4 P5](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0005), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007)_

## History

Dora and her twin brother Davy were orphaned at a young age after their father died and their sick mother passed away. Marilla Cuthbert took the twins in to live at Green Gables, where Dora quickly stood out for her proper manners and quiet demeanor compared to her mischievous brother. She assisted Marilla around the farm with tasks like picking peas, feeding chickens, and wiping dishes, while also cultivating a neat garden plot. Dora attended school, where she enjoyed her studies, though she once became frightened of going upstairs alone in the dark after hearing scary stories from classmate Mirabel Cotton. As she grew older, she maintained her quiet, reliable, and sensible nature, frequently assisting with children and household duties. On the day of Anne Shirley's wedding, fifteen-year-old Dora helped entertain Diana's young children in the garden and was set to inherit Anne's old porch room at Green Gables.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v4 c4 P2](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0002), [v4 c4 P3](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0003), [v4 c4 P5](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0005), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007)_
